## Checklist

- [ ] I read [AGENTS.md](../blob/main/AGENTS.md) (and the category's AGENTS.md) and reused the shared code in `assets/js/lib/` where it fits.
- [ ] It still runs with `npx serve .`: no build step, no framework, no backend, and files never leave the user's device.
- [ ] No console errors, and the layout works at 390 px wide in light and dark themes.
- [ ] Media tools: Export video, Export GIF and Export PNG all work.
- [ ] Any new CDN library is pinned to an exact version and loaded lazily.
- [ ] Only made-up names in UI, thumbnails and generated content; no real brands, logos or game assets.
- [ ] New tool: registered in `assets/js/tools.js` with a thumbnail, and added to the tool lists in `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`.
- [ ] I updated the relevant AGENTS.md.
- [ ] New files start with the attribution header (copy it from any existing file), and I didn't remove any existing attribution.
